narrative.overview: Merkaz is an Operate-mode file library. The visual world comes from the community brand mark (mustard brushstroke). The UI should feel like a calm community desk: warm, clear, competent. Brand yellow is rare; ink handles commitment; soft mist and white panels carry the work.
keyCharacteristics: Mustard brand accent on focus, active tabs, and soft action fills
Ink primary buttons in light mode; brand yellow primary in dark mode
Centered panels on mist with soft panel shadows
Overflow admin actions in a vertical 3-dot menu

rules.name: The One Brush Rule
rules.body: Brand yellow appears as accent or soft fill, never as large decorative gradients or purple-tinted AI skins.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: UI headings use sentence case, not Title Case Everywhere.

rules.name: The Resting Flat Rule
rules.body: Rows and list items are flat. Lift belongs to the page panel and open menus/modals.

dos: Do keep brand yellow rare and meaningful (focus, active, soft fills).
Do center Operate panels on mist; keep #root filling the viewport.
Do collapse overflowing row actions into the 3-dot menu.
Do use Assistant and sentence-case headings.
Do preserve logo assets at /assets/icons/banner-logo.webp and dark variant.
donts: Don't reintroduce Material purple, Inter, or generic AI gradient heroes.
Don't wrap four action buttons into multi-line table cells.
Don't use emoji as icons; use the SVG set in client/src/components/Icons.tsx.
Don't treat SPA routes like /uploads as API 404s.
Don't bring back the challenge/puzzle shell unless product asks for it.
